# openprovider_dns_template (Resource)

Manages a DNS template: a set of records that a new zone can start with (`template_name` of `openprovider_dns_zone`). The API has no call to change a template, so a change of any argument replaces the template. A zone that was created from a template keeps its records when the template is replaced or deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openprovider_dns_template" "web" {
  name = "web"

  records = [
    {
      name  = "www"
      type  = "A"
      value = "192.0.2.1"
      ttl   = 3600
    },
    {
      name     = ""
      type     = "MX"
      value    = "mail.example.com"
      ttl      = 3600
      priority = 10
    },
  ]
}

# A new zone starts with the records of the template.
resource "openprovider_dns_zone" "example" {
  zone_name     = "example.com"
  template_name = openprovider_dns_template.web.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the template.
- `records` (Attributes Set) The records of the template. A record name is relative to the zone (for example `www`, or empty for the zone itself). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

### Optional

- `is_spamexperts_enabled` (Boolean) Whether a zone from this template uses SpamExperts. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier of the template at OpenProvider.

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the record, relative to the zone.
- `ttl` (Number) The time-to-live in seconds.
- `type` (String) The record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, ...).
- `value` (String) The value of the record.

Optional:

- `priority` (Number) The priority of an MX or SRV record. Defaults to 0.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A template is imported by its numeric id.
terraform import openprovider_dns_template.web 42
```
